description: The plot illustrates how MRR@10 varies with the number of queries used during inference (S) for several DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with integer tick marks. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale from 33.0 to 36.5, with ticks spaced every 0.5. A black solid line labeled “DPR w/o query” is horizontal at approximately 34.25 across all S values. A yellow solid line labeled “DPR w/ gold” starts near 33.0 at S=1 and increases steadily to about 34.95 at S=10, with intermediate points around 33.35 (S=5), 33.8 (S=6), 34.0 (S=7), and 34.5 (S=8). A green solid line with circular markers (legend entry shown as a green line with dots) rises from about 33.0 at S=1 to about 36.4 at S=10, passing through roughly 34.7 (S=2), 35.1 (S=3), 35.45 (S=4), 35.7 (S=5), 35.85 (S=6), 36.1 (S=7), 36.2 (S=8), and 36.33 (S=9). A purple solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ bottom-1” stays near 34.7–35.1, starting around 34.75 at S=1, peaking near 35.05 at S=3, then fluctuating slightly and ending around 34.7 at S=10. A blue solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ random” remains around 34.8–35.3, starting near 34.75 at S=1, reaching about 35.25–35.3 around S=3–4, and ending near 35.3 at S=10 with small oscillations in between. A red solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ curriculum” increases early from about 35.15 at S=1 to about 35.55 at S=2 and about 35.65–35.7 by S=4–5, then stays close to 35.75–35.8 through S=10, ending around 35.78. Three dashed horizontal reference lines are also shown: a red dashed line near 35.6, a purple dashed line near 34.9, and a green dashed line near 34.65.
